name: Device Mockup
summary: Laptop, phone, foldable and tablet mockup that springs between devices, with a 3D fold animation and a sliding device switcher.
useWhen: A hero or feature section needs to show a product on laptop, phone, tablet and foldable
You want the shell to morph between devices and the foldable to fold open
avoidWhen: A single static screenshot frame is enough
The screen content must be a live iframe (screens are React nodes here)
source: https://github.com/Meerzus/cloudlet (apps/site hero device stage); anatomy adapted from react-mockframe and Marvel devices.css (MIT)
